Knobs & Nubs

Topper candidates for the agentpad13 — every clearance recomputed from the primary drawings, every render generated from the candidate geometry with the real SW4 keycap in place. Pick by eye; the numbers are already proven.

Decisions

1

Knob height: +27.0 — effectively settled by the drawing.

The board's own footprinted part (Alps EC11E "H20") has its shaft tip at +24.5 (verified on the Alps catalogue drawing: 4.5 body + 20 actuator = 24.5 overall). +27.0 is the shortest knob that swallows it uncut with 1.0 mm headroom — 9.4 mm proud of the caps, plain-walled through the keycap zone, the reference proportion. The ladder (+22…+28) is below if you want to eye-adjust; +24 rides 2 mm proud.

2

Which knobs ship: A helical, B2 scoop, C cross-hatch?

Recommended: all three. B1 (the deepest CM-faithful scoop) is NOT height-fixable — the cove cost is height-invariant (−2.591 bore) — so it only fits the shorter Bourns L15 shaft: a footnote variant, not the catalog scoop.

3

Nub top: C1 cup or C2 dots?

Pure eye pick — identical Ø6.19 body, +0.250 at full throw.

4

TPU puck: X-dashes or plain?

Eye pick. One part now — no ring, no snap joint: the single conservative geometry covers the module's whole ±0.5 seat tolerance (stop 8.4–22.5°, never touches the key), TPU makes the stop a soft ramp, and worst case still uses well over a third of the pot's electrical range. The can-top measurement request is withdrawn.

5

Knob OD: Ø19 stands.

Fully hides the opening (+0.190), clears the neighbour cap by +0.950.

Proofs

Keycap height — inserted, not stackedcap rim seats on the stem shoulder +11.6 overlap 3.60 tops +17.6 dish / +18.2 plateau

The naive cap+switch stack would say +21.2 — exactly 3.60 too high. Every number below keys off the inserted tops.

Height ladder +22 … +28+27: Alps headroom +1.0, engagement 10.0 +24: rides 2.0 proud

Shaft spec — closed

No measurements needed (owner ruling: published schematics)

Locked to the Alps EC11E catalogue drawing matching the board's own footprint: Ø6.0 shaft, 4.5 across-flat, flat = outer 10 mm, tip +24.5, bushing Ø7 to +11.5 — plus a round Ø6 journal +11.5…+14.5 that v1's bore missed and v2 handles. The D-bore fit ladder absorbs generic unit variance. Bourns L15 parts fit everything except B1-scoop-free.
